rules.text: Agents are unlimited. There is no fee per agent. Customers pay only for usage (minutes and texts). Many customers can use one shared agent, each with its own number and number prompt. Use separate agents only for different knowledge or agent settings. List page size, knowledge-base quotas and simultaneous-call limits do not cap agent count.
rules.why: Agent creation carries no separate charge. The number of rows on a list page is a pagination setting.

rules.text: Group numbers by the knowledge and agent settings their customers need. Attribute each customer’s usage to its verified business number.
A separate agent does not create a separate account capacity budget.
rules.instead: Pace customers’ work in your application. Use independent accounts for independent budgets.

rules.text: Save the customer and verified business number with each request.
Knowledge-base quotas and simultaneous calls have independent limits. Neither is a limit on how many agents you may create.
Read account usage or narrow the usage report to a specific owned business number.
A carrier_outcome_unknown response needs reconciliation before another call. Use its request receipt to avoid duplicate usage.
